item.title: Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27 Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) October 19-21, 2026
item.description: On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation, the MPC at its meeting today decided to keep the policy repo rate unchanged.
